items.title: Emile Barnes and Paul Barnes Interview, 1959-10-01
items.q: when I would take lessons with Lorenzo Teo

ctx.x: I was wondering about Teo since he's not living of course and we never found very much information about Teo. Do you remember much about how he played and what he told you when he helped you or what

he was like? For his playing, actually I think that he was one of the greatest players we had here at that time. Lorenzo Teo, his tone and all was so smooth. But mostly when I would take lessons with Lorenzo Teo, he was always tipsy. Sometimes I couldn't get my lesson. He was always tipsy. Somebody told me he liked wine a lot.
Is that it or what? I didn't know.
